race.comment: TASMAN JEWEL (6) gets top billing after resuming with a second at this track, where she was beaten just under six lengths by Ravin' Ava but still beat a number of these home. Faithfull hops on board now and this looks a perfect opportunity to go one better. TWISTED TRICKSTER (1) is the main danger if forgiven for the Bunbury failure, where he was sent out favourite, raced wide early and weakened badly over 1400m. His Northam run prior was much better when beaten just over two lengths, and he has placed at this trip. LUZ DEL SOL (8) was only beaten just over three lengths first-up and has rating angles in her favour. Can improve here and can play a leading role. ZESTY ZOOM (9) made some late ground here last start and is fitter again. Can feature. MENOMONEE BRAVE (4) is better suited at this distance and won't be far away.
